title: Finish Through the Help
description: A driver attacks the rim as a help defender steps over, practising the finish adjustment needed when help arrives from the weak side.

content.objective: Adjust the finish — shoulder, floater or kick-out — based on where help defense arrives from.
content.setup: A driver attacks from the wing as a help defender steps over from the weak side at the last moment.
instructions: The driver attacks hard toward the rim as if no help is there.
As the help defender steps over, the driver chooses: finish away from the help, use a floater, or kick out to an open spot.
Vary which choice the driver makes each rep to practise reading, not repeating.
Rotate the help defender's timing — early, late, and on-time — across reps.
coachingPoints: Keep the eyes up to see the help arriving.
Protect the ball on the side the help is coming from.
Decide early — hesitating in the air leads to turnovers.
commonMistakes: Driving with the head down and missing the help defender entirely.
Forcing a finish into the helper instead of adjusting.
Finishing off the wrong foot for the angle of approach.
content.safety: Help defenders contest with verticality, no undercutting the shooter.
